high_level_description: This image captures the iconic Empire State Building in New York City during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the warm hues in the sky transitioning from blue to orange. The building is illuminated with vibrant red lights on its upper sections, contrasting with the darkened lower parts of the structure. The spire at the top of the building is lit up in blue, adding to the colorful display. The Empire State Building stands tall against the backdrop of a clear sky, which gradually shifts in color from deep blue at the top to a softer gradient near the horizon.
